engine_csv.completion_limit: Use engine default blocking finalization with the normal processing thread to avoid the installed UE5.8 nonblocking Stop retry race. engine_csv.source: Owned cooked-process engine CSV; raw GPUTime/GPUMem/animation counters are separate from inline manual CPU/RHI/DXGI summaries.

engine_csv.gpu_timing_status: Not inferred here; inspect finalized raw GPUTime for valid positive samples. Missing/nonpositive GPUTime is unavailable, never substituted with CPU/wall time.
